description: Every testbench behind a claimed number for sg13g2-noc: the endpoints loopback (#19), the isolated router (#18) and the 2 x 2 mesh (#25) cocotb benches, each with negative controls, run from one cold-start command. The pins repeat layout/pdk.json and layout/tools.json; verification/run.sh refuses a tool that differs from layout/tools.json.
